# The executor prompt does not say that the PR body carries no "Generated by" footer
- where: `docs/backlog/prompts/executor.md` (step 1.11, PR body)
- why it matters: the cloud harness asks agents to end PR bodies with a "Generated by" footer, which collides with CLAUDE.md ("No AI-attribution lines in commits or PR descriptions") and fails review on every PR
- found by: WR-001, reviewer, 2026-11-25
